title: The Last Letter Before the Storm
opening: The old harbour post office is moving. Behind cabinet K, your delivery team finds a sealed letter posted ten years ago. Only M. V. and part of the old workshop address remain readable. Before the evening bell pauses deliveries for the approaching storm, find its owner and make a verified handover. Everyone is safe indoors. There is no real countdown: thinking and hints never cost action spaces.

blocks.title: Original article / 14 May
blocks.text: "Swallow Works, at old number 18, reopens its doors. Its owner builds wooden BOATS beneath the painted SWALLOW emblem."

blocks.title: Correction / 15 May
blocks.text: "Yesterday's Swallow Works report contained one error: the old door number was printed with an extra leading digit 1. The owner's trade and painted emblem were reported correctly. We apologise for the typesetting mistake."

blocks.title: Archive desk notice
blocks.text: A later street-renaming notice is filed with the current resident register. Do not treat an old workshop number as a current delivery address.

Record the corrected OLD number, the TRADE and the EMBLEM with their supporting sentences. Source N-02. Explain which field changes and which remain valid. Ask for a check, then return to map 3 for the Act 4 choice. The route cost already includes the return.

blocks.title: Read your matching delivery scene
blocks.text: PERSONAL: at the correct door, Mara shows her seal. You finish the receipt and hand over the unopened letter before the bell. COLLECTION: the checked collector signs the receipt; the unopened letter enters its verified bag before the bell. After the storm, Mara confirms its safe arrival. Both fulfil the promise.

blocks.title: If you helped
blocks.text: Staff thank you: Leon, Pia and Rae's collection slips are now correctly filed. Your earned pre-check made the final handover shorter. If you continued, recall how you built and verified the full chain yourselves. Neither choice earns a higher score.
The next morning, Mara invites your team to share the letter from her childhood friend Iris. It was written before Iris moved away ten years ago.

blocks.title: Dear Mara,
blocks.text:
I packed the little boat last. The sail is still crooked, just as we left it. I thought a boat had to be perfect before it could go anywhere. You taught me we could keep making it better together.

I have not forgotten our workshop, or you. I left a forwarding reference with the town post office, in case you would like to write. Perhaps one day we can finish the second sail.

Your friend, Iris

Mara sets a fresh page on the bench. "Dear Iris," she writes, "I kept the second sail." Forwarding reference IF-6 will be checked by the reopened desk before the reply is sent. This is fiction; no real contact is needed.

guide.title: A clear finish and an honest restart

blocks.text: Give ending 20 after verified receipt 6. Read its personal or collection scene, then the shared next-day letter. Include the matching help/continue acknowledgement and ask every player to name a useful finding.

blocks.title: Letter privacy
blocks.text: The investigation never opens the letter. Mara chooses to share it next day. Collection succeeds at verified authorised handover; later arrival is confirmed in the ending.

blocks.title: If a paper record is wrong
blocks.text: Recalculate 6 minus the committed route cost, minus help 1 if chosen, minus final cost only if completed. Correct the record; do not invent penalties or secretly change a choice. Hints and spoken reasoning are welcome.

blocks.title: Companion and preset printing
blocks.text: Before play, Adult preparation offers full choice, preset route, preset route+tool, or fixed-run settings. Match those settings to the printed recipe. Choices remain open only when corresponding sheets are printed. PDFs stay beside HTML after extraction.

blocks.title: Save and reset
blocks.text: Milestones/choices save on this browser if permitted. No typed answers are uploaded. If storage is blocked, keep the tab open. After a lost tab, continue on paper with this guide or replay checked inputs from log 2; there is no automatic restoration without storage. Reset asks before clearing this game's progress.
Replay can explore another route/tool, but the recipient and historical facts remain familiar. No account, purchase, online generation, real contact or external service is needed to play.
